01 — The Context

What organizations typically face.

Mid-to-large organizations carry operational complexity across departments and tools. Data moves between systems by spreadsheet, reporting is assembled by hand, and AI adoption happens in pockets rather than as a program.

The work is to connect it, report on it, and give teams AI that fits their process: automation where the handoffs are, dashboards that report on themselves, and training built around the organization's own work.
